title: garcinia pluvialis
intro: Garcinia pluvialis, commonly known as the tropical garcinia, is a plant species in the family Clusiaceae. This plant is traditionally used for its health benefits, which include aiding in weight management, reducing inflammation, and lowering cholesterol levels. Garcinia pluvialis has been reported to exhibit therapeutic actions such as antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which contribute to its medicinal value. The bioactive constituents of Garcinia pluvialis include flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its various health benefits.
